sentences.Skal vi gå ut og spise i kveld?: Shall we go out to eat tonight?
sentences.Jeg … jeg tror ikke at jeg orker. Jeg fø: I … I don't think I have the energy. I'm feeling a bit unwell.
sentences.Du ser litt blek ut. Er du syk?: You look a bit pale. Are you ill?
sentences.Jeg vet ikke, men jeg har hodepine og vo: I don't know, but I have a headache and a sore neck.
sentences.Hvor lenge har du følt deg sånn?: How long have you felt like this?
For a week, and it's a bit worse today.
sentences.Jeg synes at du skal ringe til fastlegen: I think you should ring your GP and make an appointment.
sentences.Jeg tror at det går over. Jeg føler meg: I think it will pass. I'm sure I'll feel better tomorrow.
OK, I'll ring the doctor tomorrow.
sentences.Bjørnar ringer fastlegen, og legen hans: Bjørnar rings his GP, and his doctor has a free appointment.
sentences.Legen undersøker Bjørnar grundig og tar: The doctor examines Bjørnar thoroughly and takes blood tests.
sentences.Det er ikke noe alvorlig. Stresser du my: It's nothing serious. Are you very stressed?
sentences.Nei, men jeg jobber veldig mye og har ba: No, but I work a lot and have my children every other week. Besides, I spend a lot of time in the garage in the evenings, and I often help my friends at weekends.
Maybe I have a bit too much to do.
Yes, I run several times a week.
sentences.Det er bra at du trener, men når slapper: It's good that you exercise, but when do you relax?
sentences.Jeg slapper av sammen med Ingrid, ei dam: I relax with Ingrid, a woman I've got to know. We laugh a lot and have a nice time together.
sentences.Ja, men hvorfor har jeg vondt i nakken?: Yes, but why does my neck hurt?
sentences.Jeg tror at du stresser for mye. Du bør: I think you're too stressed. You should make an appointment with a physiotherapist, and you must remember to relax. You can buy painkillers at the pharmacy. I also think you should spend more time with Ingrid.
Bjørnar goes out and gets into the car.
He thinks about what the doctor said.
sentences.Nå skal han jobbe litt mindre og kose se: Now he is going to work a bit less and have a bit more fun with Ingrid.
sentences.Bjørnar føler seg dårlig, og han har von: Bjørnar feels unwell, and he has a pain in his head and neck.
It has got worse over the last week.
sentences.Ingrid synes at han skal bestille en tim: Ingrid thinks he should make an appointment with his GP.
sentences.Legen spør om Bjørnar stresser for mye,: The doctor asks if Bjørnar is too stressed, and says that he should go to a physiotherapist.
sentences.Legen sier også at Bjørnar må huske å sl: The doctor also says that Bjørnar must remember to relax more and spend more time with Ingrid.
sentences.Bjørnar gleder seg til å være mer sammen: Bjørnar is looking forward to spending more time with her.
